title: Fake Backpacker Job
scenario: A hostel contact offers paid work but asks for passport scans and fees first.

answers.A: Verify the employer, contract, and work permission independently.
answers.B: Pay the fee and send passport scans to start the job.
answers.C: Send the passport scan but wait to pay until arrival.
answers.D: Use a recognised job platform or local employment service.

explanation: A real job should explain the employer, work permission, pay, and contract. Fees and document demands before verification are warning signs.
proTip: Work abroad requires a lawful offer, not just a friendly hostel message.
